approvalStatus: Verified against public ingredient table; not batch-certified or professionally reviewed
discrepancies: Narrative names soy and ragi, absent from the table.
FAQ refers to wheat plus 18 ingredients; table contains 18 total.
Moong / lentil identity needs product-specific clarification.

ingredients.name: Whole Wheat Flour
ingredients.note: Whole-wheat flour is the largest component of the published blend. Contains gluten.

ingredients.name: Barley Flour
ingredients.note: Barley is a cereal. Its presence means removing wheat alone does not remove gluten.

ingredients.name: Oat Flour
ingredients.note: Milled oats are listed separately from oat bran. Cross-contact controls are not verified.

ingredients.name: Whole Kala Chana Flour
ingredients.note: Whole black chickpea flour is a pulse ingredient, not a cereal grain.

ingredients.name: Oat Bran
ingredients.note: Bran is an oat fraction. The published table treats it as its own ingredient.

ingredients.name: Chana Dal Besan
ingredients.note: Chana dal flour is listed separately from whole kala chana flour; do not merge their proportions.

ingredients.name: Moong / Lentil Flour
ingredients.note: The source uses an ambiguous moong/lentil label. Ask SadaPure which pulse is used if identity matters.

ingredients.name: Sorghum Flour
ingredients.note: Jowar is a cereal ingredient. Its presence does not make the finished blend gluten-free.

ingredients.name: Millet Flour
ingredients.note: Bajra is a millet flour. The recipe percentage describes quantity, not a health ranking.

ingredients.name: Sesame Seeds
ingredients.note: Sesame is explicitly present in the original blend. Avoid the blend if you have sesame allergy.

ingredients.name: Flaxseed Meal
ingredients.note: Ground flaxseed is a seed ingredient. Follow the pack's storage directions.

ingredients.name: Whole Corn Flour
ingredients.note: The table specifies whole corn flour, not corn starch. These are not interchangeable ingredients.

ingredients.name: Psyllium Husk
ingredients.note: A husk ingredient rather than a grain. This calculator scales the published amount without therapeutic advice.

ingredients.name: Rye Flour
ingredients.note: Rye contains gluten. The Urdu/common-name wording follows the source and should be confirmed where identity is unclear.

ingredients.name: Chia Seeds
ingredients.note: Chia is a seed ingredient. A small percentage is still shown individually in every result.

ingredients.name: Cumin Seeds
ingredients.note: Cumin is a spice ingredient. Its weight is calculated from the same source as the main grains.

ingredients.name: Fenugreek Seeds
ingredients.note: Fenugreek is listed as a spice/seed ingredient. Ingredient-specific allergies can occur beyond highlighted categories.

ingredients.name: Moringa Leaf Powder
ingredients.note: Moringa leaf is not a grain. Its inclusion does not establish a clinical benefit for the finished flour.
